title: Add 'Make Active Profile on All Modes' button to provider settings
author: crazyrabbit0
lessons: File count is misleading for i18n-heavy PRs -- 65 of 71 files are translation updates, real review surface is 6 files
Existing API reuse is the mark of good feature work -- no new patterns invented, pure composition of existing primitives
UI sync after backend changes is easy to miss in extension/webview architectures where state lives in two places
